name: Prompt da recuperação
summary: Guia de estilo da Recuperação: uma causa, uma ação da lista permitida, nunca repetir trabalho biométrico.

variables.name: failedStageId
variables.description: RecoveryPacket.inputs.failedStep.stageId: the stage of the failed step (A5 stage id).

variables.name: failedStep
variables.description: RecoveryPacket.inputs.failedStep.step: one of brief, preflight, snapshot, execute, verify, archive, record.

variables.name: failureReason
variables.description: RecoveryPacket.inputs.failedStep.failureReason: redacted, delimited data, at most 2000 characters.

variables.name: allowedActions
variables.description: RecoveryPacket.inputs.allowedActions: the action kinds the engine accepts for this step.

notes: Bound to slot prompt:recovery. Topology v1 RecoveryPacket has no prompt field, so in R1 the engine records this version for prompt-version metering only (topology section 10); the role's built-in prompt recovery@1 drives the call. Output contract: RecoveryAction (C7).
